answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while attestations link behavior across identities. If k identities coordinate equivocation, the attributable penalty grows as O(k^2), rather than linearly; detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s aggregate capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation preventing recovery through replacement accounts. A quill may help forge a signature, but it cannot conceal a correlated terrace of claims.
